blocks.text: Sozish (inflammation) infection ka sab se aam ghair makhsoos jawab hai. Infected ya zakhmi cells histamine aur prostaglandins jaise kimiyai ishare chhorte hain jo muqami khoon ki naliyan phaila kar us jagah capillaries mein khoon ka bahao barhate hain; capillaries zyada rasne wali bhi ho jati hain. Nateeja surkhi, soojan aur garmi hai: sozish. Garmi jagah ko jaraseem ke barhne ke liye na-munasib banati, shifa barhati aur safaid khoon ke cells ki harkat tez karti hai.

blocks.alt: Baayen se daayen teen hisse. 1: pin jild ki satah chhed kar bacteria andar le jata; kimiyai ishaare chhoote; neeche khoon ki nali. 2: soojan; phagocytes aur mayi khoon ki nali se us jagah aate. 3: phagocytes bacteria aur cells ka malba nigalte.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.9: Sozish (inflammation) ka jawab (kitab ki Figure 21.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Pin, Skin surface, Bacteria, Blood vessel, Swelling, Chemical signals, Phagocytes and fluid move into area, Phagocytes engulf bacteria and cell debris.

blocks.text: Zyada phagocytes, macrophages aur neutrophils, khoon se soje tissue mein ja kar jaraseem nigalte hain. Monocytes aa kar jaraseem maarne wale kimiyai maadde chhorte aur phir macrophages murda jaraseem, cells aur malbe ki safai karte hain. Sozish ka jawab aksar jaraseem ka phailao rokne ke liye kaafi hota hai.

blocks.title: Maloomat
blocks.text: Kuch infections ki peep marte ya murda neutrophils, toote tissue cells aur murda jaraseem ka mixture hai. Kuch soorton mein, maslan arthritis mein, sozish baghair infection ya chot ke hoti hai: ghalat rukh ka immune jawab.

blocks.prompt: Soji jagah surkh, phooli aur garam kyun hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Histamine aur prostaglandins naliyan phailate (zyada khoon: surkhi aur garmi) aur capillaries rasne wali banate (tissue mein mayi: soojan).

items: Histamine aur prostaglandins capillaries phailate aur kholte: surkhi, soojan, garmi.
Phagocytes andar aate; macrophages safai karte; peep murda neutrophils aur malba hai.
